questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Newton’s Laws of Motion:
(a) Newton’s first law defines the concept of inertia.
(b) Newton’s second law provides a measure of force.
(c) Newton’s third law states that action and reaction act on the same body.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Action and reaction always act on two different bodies, not the same one.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
क्रिया और प्रतिक्रिया हमेशा दो अलग-अलग निकायों पर कार्य करते हैं, एक ही पर नहीं।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about Surface Tension is correct?

options.a: It increases with an increase in temperature.
options.b: It is responsible for the spherical shape of rain drops.
options.c: It is a molecular property of gases.
options.d: Addition of detergents increases the surface tension of water.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Surface tension acts to minimize the surface area, leading to spherical shapes. It decreases with temperature.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
पृष्ठ तनाव सतह क्षेत्र को कम करने का कार्य करता है, जिससे आकार गोलाकार हो जाता है। तापमान के साथ यह घटता है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Sound Waves:
(a) Sound waves are longitudinal mechanical waves.
(b) The speed of sound is maximum in vacuum.
(c) Speed of sound increases with increase in humidity.
 Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Sound cannot travel in a vacuum. Speed of sound is higher in moist air because moist air is less dense than dry air.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
ध्वनि निर्वात में गमन नहीं कर सकती। नम हवा में ध्वनि की गति अधिक होती है क्योंकि नम हवा शुष्क हवा की तुलना में कम घनी होती है।

questions.question: Total Internal Reflection (TIR) occurs when light travels from:

options.a: Rarer medium to denser medium at any angle.
options.b: Denser medium to rarer medium with angle of incidence greater than critical angle.
options.c: Rarer medium to denser medium with angle of incidence less than critical angle.
options.d: One medium to another with the same refractive index.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
For TIR, light must move from denser to rarer medium and the angle of incidence must exceed the critical angle.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
TIR के लिए, प्रकाश को सघन से विरल माध्यम में जाना चाहिए और आपतन कोण क्रांतिक कोण से अधिक होना चाहिए।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Archimedes' Principle:
(a) The buoyant force depends on the density of the fluid.
(b) The buoyant force depends on the mass of the object submerged.
(c) An object floats if it displaces a weight of fluid equal to its own weight.
 Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Buoyant force depends on the volume of the submerged part and density of the fluid, not the object's mass.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
उत्प्लावक बल डूबे हुए हिस्से के आयतन और द्रव के घनत्व पर निर्भर करता है, वस्तु के द्रव्यमान पर नहीं।

questions.question: Which of the following is correct about the 'Critical Mass' in a nuclear reaction?

options.a: It is the minimum mass required for a self-sustained chain reaction.
options.b: It is the mass at which an element becomes stable.
options.c: It is the maximum mass a star can have before becoming a black hole.
options.d: It is the mass of electrons in a neutral atom.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Critical mass is the smallest amount of fissile material needed for a sustained nuclear chain reaction.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
क्रांतिक द्रव्यमान निरंतर परमाणु श्रृंखला प्रतिक्रिया के लिए आवश्यक विखंडनीय सामग्री की न्यूनतम मात्रा है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about Viscosity:
(a) Viscosity of liquids decreases with increase in temperature.
(b) Viscosity of gases increases with increase in temperature.
(c) It is the internal friction between layers of a fluid.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Liquids lose viscosity when heated, while gas molecules collide more frequently, increasing their viscosity.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
गर्म करने पर द्रवों की श्यानता कम हो जाती है, जबकि गैस के अणु अधिक बार टकराते हैं, जिससे उनकी श्यानता बढ़ जाती है।

questions.question: A person is sitting in a car which is at rest. The reaction from the road at each of the four wheels of the car is 'R'. When the car runs on a straight level road, how will the reaction at the front wheels change?

options.a: It will be more than R
options.b: It will be less than R
options.c: It will remain equal to R
options.d: It depends on the speed of the car

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Due to the aerodynamic lift and shifting of weight during acceleration, the reaction at front wheels decreases.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
वायुगतिकीय उत्थान (aerodynamic lift) और त्वरण के दौरान वजन के स्थानांतरण के कारण, अगले पहियों पर प्रतिक्रिया कम हो जाती है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Electromagnetic Waves:
(a) They do not require a material medium for propagation.
(b) They are longitudinal in nature.
(c) X-rays have shorter wavelength than Radio waves.
 Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
EM waves are transverse, not longitudinal. X-rays are high frequency and low wavelength compared to Radio waves.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
विद्युत चुंबकीय तरंगें अनुप्रस्थ होती हैं, अनुदैर्ध्य नहीं। रेडियो तरंगों की तुलना में एक्स-रे उच्च आवृत्ति और कम तरंग दैर्ध्य वाली होती हैं।

questions.question: What happens to the centripetal force of an object moving in a circle if its velocity is doubled?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Centripetal force F = mv² / r. If v is doubled, v² becomes 4 times.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अभिकेंद्र बल F = mv² / r। यदि v को दोगुना किया जाता है, तो v² 4 गुना हो जाता है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Capillarity:
(a) It is caused by the combined effect of cohesion and adhesion.
(b) If the contact angle is less than 90°, the liquid level rises in the tube.
(c) Water in a capillary tube forms a convex meniscus.
 Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Water forms a concave meniscus because it wets the surface. Mercury forms a convex meniscus.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
पानी एक अवतल मेनिस्कस बनाता है क्योंकि यह सतह को भिगोता है। पारा उत्तल मेनिस्कस बनाता है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements is correct regarding the 'Escape Velocity' of Earth?

options.a: It depends on the mass of the object being launched.
options.b: It is independent of the direction of projection.
options.d: It increases with the height of the launch station.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Escape velocity ve = √ (2GM / R) is independent of the object's mass and direction. For Earth, it is 11.2 km/s.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
पलायन वेग ve = √ (2GM / R) वस्तु के द्रव्यमान और दिशा से स्वतंत्र है। पृथ्वी के लिए, यह 11.2 किमी/सेकंड है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Convex Mirrors:
(a) They always form a virtual and diminished image.
(b) They have a narrower field of view compared to plane mirrors.
(c) They are used as rear-view mirrors in vehicles.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Convex mirrors provide a wider field of view, which is why they are preferred for vehicles.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
उत्तल दर्पण व्यापक दृष्टि क्षेत्र प्रदान करते हैं, यही कारण है कि उन्हें वाहनों के लिए पसंद किया जाता है।

questions.question: The phenomenon of 'Mirage' is a result of:
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Mirages occur due to the gradual refraction of light in air layers of different densities followed by TIR.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
मृगतृष्णा अलग-अलग घनत्व वाली हवा की परतों में प्रकाश के क्रमिक अपवर्तन और उसके बाद होने वाले TIR के कारण होती है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Resistivity:
(a) It depends on the dimensions (length/area) of the material.
(b) It depends on the nature of the material and temperature.
(c) Its S.I. unit is Ohm-meter(ִΩ⋅m).
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Resistance depends on dimensions, but resistivity is an intrinsic property that depends only on material and temperature.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
प्रतिरोध आयामों पर निर्भर करता है, लेकिन प्रतिरोधकता एक आंतरिक गुण है जो केवल सामग्री और तापमान पर निर्भर करती है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Gravitational Force:
(a) It is always attractive in nature.
(b) It is the strongest force in nature.
(c) It follows the inverse square law.
 Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Gravitational force is the weakest of the four fundamental forces. Strong Nuclear Force is the strongest.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
गुरुत्वाकर्षण बल चार मौलिक बलों में सबसे कमजोर है। प्रबल नाभिकीय बल सबसे मजबूत होता है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about 'Work' is correct?

options.c: No work is done when the force is perpendicular to the displacement.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
W = Fd cos(θ). If θ = 90° (perpendicular), cos(90°) = 0, so work done is zero.
W = Fd cos(θ)

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
। यदि θ = 90° (लंबवत) है, तो cos(90°) = 0, इसलिए किया गया कार्य शून्य होता है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding a Simple Pendulum:
(a) Its time period depends on the mass of the bob.
(b) Its time period is directly proportional to the square root of its length.
(c) If taken to the Moon, its time period will increase.
 Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Time period T = 2π√(l/g). It is independent of mass. On the Moon, g decreases, so T increases.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
आवर्तकाल T = 2π√(l/g)। यह द्रव्यमान से स्वतंत्र है। चंद्रमा पर g कम हो जाता है, इसलिए T बढ़ जाता है।

questions.question: At what temperature are the Celsius and Fahrenheit scales equal?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Using the formula C/5 = (F - 32)/9, both scales meet at -40°.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सूत्र C/5 = (F - 32)/9 का उपयोग करते हुए, दोनों स्केल -40° पर मिलते हैं।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Nuclear Fusion:
(a) It is the source of energy in the Sun and stars.
(b) It requires very high temperature and pressure.
(c) Hydrogen bomb is based on the principle of nuclear fusion.
 Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
All statements are correct. Fusion involves joining light nuclei like Hydrogen to form Helium.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सभी कथन सही हैं। संलयन में हीलियम बनाने के लिए हाइड्रोजन जैसे हल्के नाभिकों को जोड़ना शामिल है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT regarding 'Ohm's Law'?

options.b: It is applicable to all types of conductors including semiconductors.
options.c: The V-I graph for an ohmic conductor is a straight line.
options.d: It relates potential difference, current, and resistance.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Ohm's Law is not applicable to non-ohmic conductors like semiconductors, vacuum tubes, or transistors.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
ओम का नियम अर्धचालक, वैक्यूम ट्यूब या ट्रांजिस्टर जैसे गैर-ओमीय चालकों पर लागू नहीं होता है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Transformers:
(a) They work on the principle of Mutual Induction.
(b) They can be used to step up or step down DC voltage.
(c) They are used to change the voltage of AC current.
 Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Transformers only work with Alternating Current (AC), not Direct Current (DC).

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
ट्रांसफॉर्मर केवल प्रत्यावर्ती धारा (AC) के साथ काम करते हैं, दिष्ट धारा (DC) के साथ नहीं।

questions.question: Which color of light deviates the most when passing through a prism?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Violet light has the shortest wavelength and highest frequency, so it deviates the most. Red deviates the least.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
बैंगनी प्रकाश की तरंग दैर्ध्य सबसे कम और आवृत्ति सबसे अधिक होती है, इसलिए यह सबसे अधिक विचलित होता है। लाल सबसे कम विचलित होता है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Friction:
(a) Static friction is always greater than kinetic friction.
(b) Friction depends on the area of contact.
(c) Lubrication is used to reduce friction.
 Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Friction is independent of the area of contact but depends on the nature of the surfaces.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
घर्षण संपर्क के क्षेत्र से स्वतंत्र होता है लेकिन सतहों की प्रकृति पर निर्भर करता है।

questions.question: Which instrument is used to measure Atmospheric Pressure?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Barometer is used for pressure. Hygrometer is for humidity, and Hydrometer is for relative density of liquids.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
बैरोमीटर का उपयोग दाब के लिए किया जाता है। हाइग्रोमीटर आर्द्रता के लिए है, और हाइड्रोमीटर तरल पदार्थों के सापेक्ष घनत्व के लिए है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Ultrasound Waves:
(a) Their frequency is greater than 20,000 Hz.
(b) They are used in SONAR to measure ocean depth.
(c) Bats use ultrasound for navigation.
 Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
All statements are correct regarding ultrasonic waves.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अल्ट्रासोनिक तरंगों के संबंध में सभी कथन सही हैं।

questions.question: The working of a Rocket is based on the principle of conservation of:
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Rocket propulsion follows Newton's Third Law and the law of conservation of linear momentum.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
रॉकेट प्रणोदन न्यूटन के तीसरे नियम और रेखीय संवेग संरक्षण के नियम का पालन करता है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Heat Transfer:
(a) Conduction occurs mainly in solids.
(b) Convection requires a material medium.
(c) Radiation is the fastest mode of heat transfer and can occur in vacuum.
 Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Conduction and convection need a medium, while radiation (EM waves) travels at the speed of light.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
चालन और संवहन के लिए माध्यम की आवश्यकता होती है, जबकि विकिरण (EM तरंगें) प्रकाश की गति से चलती हैं।

questions.question: What happens to the weight of an object when it is taken from the Equator to the Poles?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Acceleration due to gravity (g) is maximum at poles and minimum at the equator. Weight W = mg.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
गुरुत्वाकर्षण के कारण त्वरण (g) ध्रुवों पर अधिकतम और भूमध्य रेखा पर न्यूनतम होता है। भार W = mg।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Semiconductors:
(a) Their conductivity increases with an increase in temperature.
(b) Silicon and Germanium are examples of semiconductors.
(c) Doping is the process of adding impurities to increase conductivity.
 Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Semiconductors have a negative temperature coefficient of resistance, meaning resistance decreases and conductivity increases with heat.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अर्धचालकों में प्रतिरोध का ऋणात्मक तापमान गुणांक होता है, जिसका अर्थ है कि गर्मी के साथ प्रतिरोध घटता है और चालकता बढ़ती है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Radioactivity:
(a) Alpha particles have the highest ionizing power.
(b) Gamma rays have the highest penetrating power.
(c) Beta particles are positively charged.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Beta particles are fast-moving electrons, hence they are negatively charged.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
बीटा कण तेजी से चलने वाले इलेक्ट्रॉन होते हैं, इसलिए वे ऋणात्मक रूप से आवेशित होते हैं।

questions.question: Which of the following is correct regarding the 'Power of a Lens'?

options.b: It is directly proportional to the focal length.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Power P = 1/f. It is inversely proportional to focal length. Convex lenses have positive power, and concave lenses have negative power.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
शक्ति P = 1/f । यह फोकल लंबाई के व्युत्क्रमानुपाती है। उत्तल लेंस में धनात्मक शक्ति और अवतल लेंस में ऋणात्मक शक्ति होती है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about Magnetic Lines of Force:
(a) They form closed continuous loops.
(b) They intersect each other at the poles.
(c) Outside the magnet, they move from North pole to South pole.
 Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Magnetic field lines never intersect each other at any point.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
चुंबकीय क्षेत्र रेखाएं कभी भी किसी बिंदु पर एक-दूसरे को नहीं काटती हैं।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about 'Isotopes' is correct?

options.a: They have the same number of neutrons but different atomic numbers.
options.b: They have the same atomic number but different mass numbers.
options.d: Carbon-12 and Carbon-14 are not isotopes.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Isotopes have the same number of protons (atomic number) but different number of neutrons, leading to different mass numbers.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
समस्थानिकों में प्रोटॉन की संख्या (परमाणु क्रमांक) समान होती है लेकिन न्यूट्रॉन की संख्या भिन्न होती है, जिससे द्रव्यमान संख्या भिन्न हो जाती है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Bernoulli's Principle:
(a) It is based on the law of conservation of energy.
(b) As the speed of a moving fluid increases, its pressure decreases.
(c) It explains the 'lift' of an airplane wing.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Bernoulli's principle states that for an incompressible fluid, an increase in velocity occurs simultaneously with a decrease in pressure.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
बरनौली का सिद्धांत बताता है कि एक असम्पीडित द्रव के लिए, वेग में वृद्धि दबाव में कमी के साथ-साथ होती है।

questions.question: Which of the following is correct regarding 'Myopia' (Short-sightedness)?

options.a: The person cannot see nearby objects clearly.
options.b: The image is formed behind the retina.
options.c: It is corrected using a Concave lens.
options.d: It is corrected using a Convex lens.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
In myopia, the eyeball is elongated and the image forms in front of the retina. A diverging (concave) lens is needed for correction.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
मायोपिया में, नेत्रगोलक लंबा हो जाता है और प्रतिबिंब रेटिना के सामने बनता है। सुधार के लिए अपसारी (अवतल) लेंस की आवश्यकता होती है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Heat and Temperature:
(a) Heat is a form of energy.
(b) Temperature is the degree of hotness or coldness.
(c) Heat flows from a body at lower temperature to a body at higher temperature spontaneously.
 Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
According to the Second Law of Thermodynamics, heat always flows from a higher temperature to a lower temperature spontaneously.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
ऊष्मागतिकी के दूसरे नियम के अनुसार, ऊष्मा हमेशा उच्च तापमान से निम्न तापमान की ओर स्वतः प्रवाहित होती है।

questions.question: In which medium does light travel the slowest?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Speed of light is inversely proportional to the refractive index. Diamond has the highest refractive index (≈ 2.42), so speed is minimum.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
प्रकाश की गति अपवर्तनांक के व्युत्क्रमानुपाती होती है। हीरे का अपवर्तनांक सबसे अधिक (≈ 2.42) होता है, इसलिए गति न्यूनतम होती है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Kepler’s Laws:
(a) Planets move in elliptical orbits with the Sun at one focus.
(b) The square of the time period of a planet is proportional to the cube of its semi-major axis (T² ∝ R³).
(c) A planet moves faster when it is closer to the Sun.
 Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
All statements are correct. These are Kepler's three laws of planetary motion.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सभी कथन सही हैं। ये ग्रहों की गति के केपलर के तीन नियम हैं।

questions.question: Which property of light causes the 'Blue color of the sky'?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Rayleigh scattering causes shorter wavelengths (blue) to scatter more than longer wavelengths (red).

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
रेले प्रकीर्णन के कारण लंबी तरंग दैर्ध्य (लाल) की तुलना में छोटी तरंग दैर्ध्य (नीला) अधिक प्रकीर्णित होती है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Photoelectric Effect:
(a) It demonstrates the particle nature of light.
(b) Kinetic energy of emitted electrons depends on the intensity of light.
(c) It was explained by Albert Einstein using the concept of Photons.
 Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Kinetic energy of photoelectrons depends on the frequency of light, while the number of electrons (current) depends on intensity.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
फोटोइलेक्ट्रॉनों की गतिज ऊर्जा प्रकाश की आवृत्ति पर निर्भर करती है, जबकि इलेक्ट्रॉनों की संख्या (धारा) तीव्रता पर निर्भर करती है।

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of an 'Inelastic Collision'?

options.b: A mud ball sticking to a wall after hitting it.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
In a perfectly inelastic collision, kinetic energy is not conserved and the objects stick together.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
एक पूर्णतः अप्रत्यास्थ टक्कर में, गतिज ऊर्जा संरक्षित नहीं रहती है और वस्तुएं आपस में चिपक जाती हैं।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Surface Tension and Capillarity:
(a) Insects can walk on water due to surface tension.
(b) Capillary rise is zero in space (weightlessness).
(c) Hot soup is tastier because it has lower surface tension.
 Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
In weightlessness, g=0. Since capillary rise h = (2T cosθ) / (rρg), if g=0, h becomes infinite (the liquid fills the tube completely), not zero.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
भारहीनता में, g=0। चूँकि केशिकत्व उत्थान h = (2T cosθ) / (rρg) है, यदि g=0 है, तो h अनंत हो जाता है (तरल ट्यूब को पूरी तरह भर देता है), शून्य नहीं।

questions.question: The resistance of an ideal Ammeter and an ideal Voltmeter should be:
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
An ideal ammeter should have zero resistance to not affect current, while a voltmeter should have infinite resistance to not draw any current.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
एक आदर्श एमीटर में धारा को प्रभावित न करने के लिए शून्य प्रतिरोध होना चाहिए, जबकि वोल्टमीटर में कोई धारा न खींचने के लिए अनंत प्रतिरोध होना चाहिए।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements about Primary Colors of Light:
(a) The primary colors are Red, Green, and Blue.
(b) Mixing all three primary colors of light produces Black.
(c) Secondary colors are formed by mixing two primary colors.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Mixing the three primary colors of light (Additive mixing) produces White light, not Black.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
प्रकाश के तीन प्राथमिक रंगों को मिलाने (योगात्मक मिश्रण) से सफेद प्रकाश बनता है, काला नहीं।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Ideal Gases:
(a) There are no intermolecular forces of attraction between gas molecules.
(b) The volume of the molecules is negligible compared to the total volume of the gas.
(c) Ideal gas behavior is observed at low temperature and high pressure.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Real gases behave ideally at high temperature and low pressure.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
वास्तविक गैसें उच्च तापमान और निम्न दबाव पर आदर्श रूप से व्यवहार करती हैं।

questions.question: Which of the following is correct regarding a 'Fuse Wire' used in domestic circuits?

options.a: It has high melting point and high resistance.
options.b: It has low melting point and high resistance.
options.c: It is connected in parallel to the circuit.
options.d: It is made of pure copper.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
A fuse wire must have a low melting point so that it melts during overcurrent. It has high resistance to produce sufficient heat.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
फ्यूज तार का गलनांक कम होना चाहिए ताकि अत्यधिक धारा के दौरान वह पिघल जाए। पर्याप्त गर्मी पैदा करने के लिए इसमें उच्च प्रतिरोध होता है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Heat Engines:
(a) No heat engine can have 100% efficiency.
(b) Efficiency of a Carnot engine depends on the nature of the working substance.
(c) Efficiency increases if the temperature of the sink is decreased.
 Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Efficiency η = 1 - T(sink) / T(source). It is independent of the working substance and depends only on temperatures.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
दक्षता η = 1 - T(sink) / T(source)। यह कार्यकारी पदार्थ से स्वतंत्र है और केवल तापमान पर निर्भर करती है।

questions.question: Which phenomenon is responsible for the 'Twinkling of Stars'?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Stars twinkle due to continuous refraction of starlight as it passes through different layers of the atmosphere with varying densities.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
वायुमंडल की विभिन्न घनत्व वाली परतों से गुजरते समय तारों के प्रकाश के निरंतर अपवर्तन के कारण तारे टिमटिमाते हैं।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding X-Rays:
(a) They are deflected by electric and magnetic fields.
(b) They travel at the speed of light.
(c) They can pass through human flesh but are absorbed by bones.
 Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
X-rays are electromagnetic waves (neutral) and are not deflected by electric or magnetic fields.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
एक्स-रे विद्युत चुंबकीय तरंगें (तटस्थ) हैं और विद्युत या चुंबकीय क्षेत्रों द्वारा विक्षेपित नहीं होती हैं।

questions.question: Which of the following is correct regarding 'Latent Heat'?

options.a: It causes an increase in temperature of the substance.
options.b: It is the heat required for a change of state without changing the temperature.
options.c: Latent heat of vaporization of water is less than latent heat of fusion.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Latent heat is used to break/form molecular bonds during phase change at constant temperature.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
गुप्त ऊष्मा का उपयोग स्थिर तापमान पर अवस्था परिवर्तन के दौरान आणविक बंधों को तोड़ने/बनाने के लिए किया जाता है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding simple harmonic motion (SHM):
(a) Acceleration is always proportional to the displacement from mean position.
(b) Velocity is maximum at the extreme positions.
(c) Kinetic energy is maximum at the mean position.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
In SHM, velocity is zero at extreme positions and maximum at the mean position.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
SHM में, चरम स्थितियों पर वेग शून्य और माध्य स्थिति पर अधिकतम होता है।

questions.question: Which of the following is an 'Ohmic Conductor'?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Metals like silver and copper obey Ohm's law (V ∝ I) at constant temperature. Others listed are semiconductor devices (non-ohmic).

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
चांदी और तांबे जैसी धातुएं स्थिर तापमान पर ओम के नियम (V ∝ I) का पालन करती हैं। सूचीबद्ध अन्य अर्धचालक उपकरण (गैर-ओमीय) हैं।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Centrifugal Force:
(a) It is a pseudo-force observed in non-inertial frames.
(b) It acts towards the center of the circular path.
(c) It is used in cream separators to separate cream from milk.
 Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Centrifugal force acts away from the center. Centripetal force acts towards the center.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
अपकेन्द्री बल केंद्र से दूर कार्य करता है। अभिकेंद्र बल केंद्र की ओर कार्य करता है।

questions.question: In a step-up transformer, which of the following increases in the secondary coil?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
A step-up transformer increases voltage while decreasing current to keep power constant (ideally). Frequency remains unchanged.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
स्टेप-अप ट्रांसफॉर्मर वोल्टेज बढ़ाता है जबकि शक्ति को स्थिर रखने के लिए धारा को कम करता है। आवृत्ति अपरिवर्तित रहती है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Longitudinal Waves:
(a) Particle vibration is parallel to the direction of wave propagation.
(b) They can be polarized.
(c) Sound waves in air are longitudinal waves.
 Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Only transverse waves (like light) can be polarized. Longitudinal waves cannot be polarized.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
केवल अनुप्रस्थ तरंगों (जैसे प्रकाश) को ध्रुवित किया जा सकता है। अनुदैर्ध्य तरंगों को ध्रुवित नहीं किया जा सकता।

questions.question: Which color of light is least scattered by fog or smoke?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Red has the longest wavelength, so it is scattered the least. That's why danger signals are red.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
लाल रंग की तरंग दैर्ध्य सबसे लंबी होती है, इसलिए यह सबसे कम प्रकीर्णित होता है। इसीलिए खतरे के संकेत लाल होते हैं।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Mass and Weight:
(a) Mass is a scalar quantity while weight is a vector quantity.
(b) Mass of an object remains constant everywhere.
(c) Weight of an object becomes zero at the center of the Earth.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
All statements are correct. Weight W = mg. At the center of Earth, g = 0, so W = 0.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सभी कथन सही हैं। भार W = mg। पृथ्वी के केंद्र पर g = 0, इसलिए W = 0

questions.question: The magnetic field inside a long current-carrying solenoid is:

options.d: Varies with distance from the axis

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Inside a solenoid, the magnetic field lines are parallel and uniform.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
एक सोलेनोइड के अंदर, चुंबकीय क्षेत्र रेखाएं समानांतर और एकसमान होती हैं।

questions.question: Which of the following is correct regarding 'Kirchhoff's First Law' (Junction Rule)?

options.a: It is based on the conservation of energy.
options.b: It states that the algebraic sum of currents at a junction is zero.
options.c: It is based on the conservation of mass.
options.d: It is used to find the voltage in a closed loop.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Kirchhoff's First Law is based on the conservation of charge.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
किरचॉफ का पहला नियम आवेश के संरक्षण पर आधारित है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Radioactivity and Nuclear Energy:
(a) Nuclear Fission is used in Nuclear Reactors for electricity generation.
(b) Control rods in nuclear reactors are made of materials like Boron or Cadmium.
(c) Heavy water (D₂O) is used as a fuel in nuclear reactors.
 Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Heavy water is used as a moderator or coolant to slow down neutrons, not as a fuel. Uranium or Plutonium are used as fuels.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
भारी जल का उपयोग न्यूट्रॉन को धीमा करने के लिए मंदक (moderator) या शीतलक के रूप में किया जाता है, ईंधन के रूप में नहीं। यूरेनियम या प्लूटोनियम का उपयोग ईंधन के रूप में किया जाता है।

questions.question: Which of the following statements about 'Optical Fibers' is correct?

options.a: They work on the principle of Refraction.
options.b: They work on the principle of Total Internal Reflection.
options.c: They are used for generating electricity.
options.d: Information is transmitted in the form of sound waves.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Optical fibers transmit data as light pulses using the principle of Total Internal Reflection (TIR) with minimal energy loss.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
ऑप्टिकल फाइबर न्यूनतम ऊर्जा हानि के साथ पूर्ण आंतरिक परावर्तन (TIR) के सिद्धांत का उपयोग करके प्रकाश दालों के रूप में डेटा संचारित करते हैं।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Surface Tension:
(a) Surface tension is a scalar quantity.
(b) It is defined as force per unit length.
(c) The S.I. unit of surface tension is Newton-meter (N·m).
 Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The S.I. unit of surface tension is Newton per meter (N/m), not Newton-meter.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
पृष्ठ तनाव की S.I. इकाई न्यूटन प्रति मीटर (N/m) है, न कि न्यूटन-मीटर।

questions.question: Which of the following correctly describes 'Dispersion of Light'?

options.a: Bending of light when it enters from one medium to another.
options.b: Bending of light around the corners of an obstacle.
options.c: Splitting of white light into its constituent colors.
options.d: Bouncing back of light from a polished surface.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Dispersion is the splitting of white light into VIBGYOR when passing through a prism due to different speeds of different colors.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
विक्षेपण, विभिन्न रंगों की अलग-अलग गति के कारण प्रिज्म से गुजरते समय श्वेत प्रकाश का VIBGYOR में विभाजित होना है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Semiconductors and Doping:
(a) P-type semiconductors are formed by adding pentavalent impurities.
(b) N-type semiconductors are formed by adding pentavalent impurities like Phosphorus.
(c) In P-type semiconductors, holes are the majority charge carriers. / P-
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
P-type semiconductors are formed by adding trivalent impurities (like Boron or Aluminum), not pentavalent.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
P-प्रकार के अर्धचालक ट्राइवेलेंट अशुद्धियों (जैसे बोरोन या एल्युमिनियम) को मिलाने से बनते हैं, पेंटावेलेंट नहीं।

questions.question: The stars appear to move from East to West because:

options.a: All stars move from East to West.
options.b: The Earth rotates from West to East on its axis.
options.c: The Earth rotates from East to West on its axis.
options.d: The background of the universe moves.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
The apparent motion of celestial bodies is due to the Earth's rotation from West to East.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
आकाशीय पिंडों की स्पष्ट गति पृथ्वी के पश्चिम से पूर्व की ओर घूमने के कारण होती है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the Heating Effect of Electric Current:
(a) It is also known as Joule's heating.
(b) Heat produced is directly proportional to the square of the current (H ∝ I²).
(c) Electric heaters and toasters work on this principle.
 Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
All statements correctly describe Joule's Law of Heating, where H = I²Rt.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सभी कथन जूल के तापन नियम का सही वर्णन करते हैं, जहाँ H = I²Rt है।

questions.question: Which of the following is correct regarding 'Inertia'?

options.a: It is the ability of a body to change its state of rest.
options.b: Inertia is directly proportional to the mass of the object.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Inertia is the resistance of an object to any change in its motion. Mass is the measure of inertia.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
जड़त्व किसी वस्तु की अपनी गति में किसी भी परिवर्तन के प्रति प्रतिरोध है। द्रव्यमान जड़त्व का माप है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Electromagnetic Spectrum:
(a) Gamma rays have the minimum wavelength.
(b) Radio waves have the maximum wavelength.
(c) Infrared waves are used in night vision goggles.
 Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
All statements are correct. The order of wavelength is Radio > Microwave > Infrared > Visible > UV > X-ray > Gamma.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सभी कथन सही हैं। तरंग दैर्ध्य का क्रम है: रेडियो > माइक्रोवेव > इन्फ्रारेड > दृश्य > यूवी > एक्स-रे > गामा।

questions.question: Which of the following is correct regarding the 'Magnifying Glass' (Simple Microscope)?

options.b: It is a Convex lens used for viewing objects at a distance.
options.c: It is a Convex lens of short focal length.
options.d: It always forms a real and inverted image.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
A magnifying glass is a convex lens that produces a virtual, erect, and magnified image when the object is placed within its focal length.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
आवर्धक कांच एक उत्तल लेंस है जो फोकल लंबाई के भीतर वस्तु रखे जाने पर आभासी, सीधा और बड़ा प्रतिबिंब बनाता है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding Heat Radiation:
(a) Dark surfaces are better absorbers of heat than light surfaces.
(b) Rough surfaces are better emitters of heat than polished surfaces.
(c) Vacuum is necessary for heat transfer by radiation.
 Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Vacuum is not necessary for radiation, though radiation can occur through it. Radiation can also travel through transparent media.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
विकिरण के लिए निर्वात आवश्यक नहीं है, हालांकि इसके माध्यम से विकिरण हो सकता है। विकिरण पारदर्शी माध्यमों से भी यात्रा कर सकता है।

questions.question: Which of the following is correct regarding 'Capacitance'?

options.b: It is the ability to store magnetic energy.
options.c: It is defined as C = V/Q.
options.d: It increases if the distance between plates of a parallel plate capacitor is increased.

questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Capacitance is the ability to store electric charge (C = Q/V). For a parallel plate capacitor, C = ∈₀ A / d, so it decreases if distance d increases.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
धारिता विद्युत आवेश को संग्रहीत करने की क्षमता है (C = Q/V)। समानांतर प्लेट कैपेसिटर के लिए, C = ∈₀ A / d है, इसलिए दूरी d बढ़ने पर यह घट जाती है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding 'Sound Pitch' and 'Loudness':
(a) Pitch of sound depends on the frequency of vibration.
(b) Loudness of sound depends on the amplitude of vibration.
(c) Loudness is measured in Hertz.
 Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Loudness is measured in Decibels (dB). Hertz (Hz) is the unit of frequency.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
प्रबलता को डेसिबल (dB) में मापा जाता है। हर्ट्ज (Hz) आवृत्ति की इकाई है।

questions.question: Which property of a liquid is used in the working of a hydraulic lift?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
Pascal’s law states that pressure applied to an enclosed fluid is transmitted undiminished to every portion of the fluid.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
पास्कल का नियम कहता है कि एक बंद द्रव पर लगाया गया दबाव द्रव के प्रत्येक भाग में बिना कम हुए संचरित होता है।

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding G.P.S. (Global Positioning System):
(a) It uses a constellation of satellites to provide location data.
(b) It works using radio waves.
(c) It requires at least 10 satellites to determine a position on Earth.
 Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
📖 English Explanation:
GPS requires a minimum of 4 satellites to accurately determine a user's 3D position (latitude, longitude, altitude) and time.

📖 हिंदी स्पष्टीकरण:
सटीक रूप से उपयोगकर्ता की 3D स्थिति (अक्षांश, देशांतर, ऊंचाई) और समय निर्धारित करने के लिए GPS को कम से कम 4 उपग्रहों की आवश्यकता होती है।
